findings.title: Dispatch can mistake an earlier background turn for the current response
findings.description: `_collect_turns` returns as soon as it sees an own `ResultMessage` and the ledger is empty. If a previous dispatch left a background agent running, its injected follow-up can arrive after the new dispatch’s own result. That result returns immediately, leaving the injected turn unread; the next dispatch may then collect or discard it as stale. This undermines the new wait-and-join behavior. Account for outstanding work from earlier dispatches before deciding the current dispatch is complete.

findings.title: Invalid template setting-source entries are silently stringified
findings.description: The template boundary validates that `setting_sources` is a list, but converts every item with `str()`. A malformed value such as `[null]` becomes `["None"]` and is passed to the SDK as a setting source instead of being rejected. Validate each element’s type and report a `TemplateValidationError` for invalid entries.
